# Shinjuku Japanese Language Institute (SNG)

> > Leading Japanese language school in Tokyo since 1975, offering student visa programs, Saturday courses, and 420-hour teacher certification using the Ezoe teaching method.

SNG (新宿日本語学校) is an ISO 29991:2020 certified institution specializing in Japanese language education and teacher training. The school serves international students through long-term visa programs, short-term courses, and JLPT/EJU exam preparation, with multilingual support across Chinese, Russian, Indonesian, French, and Taiwanese markets.

## Key Topics

- Ezoe teaching method (江副式教授法)
- JLPT (Japanese Language Proficiency Test)
- EJU (Examination for Japanese University Admission)
- 420-hour teacher certification course
- Student visa programs
- ISO 29991:2020 certification
- Private lessons and personalized learning
- Kanji specialized instruction
- Designated school recommendation system
- FLYWIRE online payment
- Beginner to advanced level courses
- Saturday Japanese courses
- Japanese teacher training
- Shinjuku location Tokyo

## Core Programs & Courses

- [Beginner Japanese Language Courses](https://www.sng.ac.jp/course/levels/beginner): Beginner course with Ezoe method and interactive learning tools
- [初级 | 星期六日语课程 - SNG](https://www.sng.ac.jp/cn/course/levels/beginner): Beginner level course with grammar notebook and jyubako cards
- [JLPT Test Preparation Classes](https://www.sng.ac.jp/jp/course/preparation-classes/jlpt): JLPT test preparation classes at Shinjuku Japanese Language Institute
- [漢字班 | 新宿日本語學校 - SNG](https://www.sng.ac.jp/tw/course/kanji): Kanji course specializing in efficient reading and memorization methods
- [私人课程 | 星期六日语课程 - SNG](https://www.sng.ac.jp/cn/course/private-lessons): Private lessons with flexible scheduling using Ezoe teaching method

## Japanese Teacher Training

- [コース | 日本語教師養成講座 新宿日本語学校](https://www.sng.ac.jp/teacher-training/course): 420-hour teacher training course for Japanese teacher certification
- [新宿日本語学校の特徴 | 日本語教師養成講座 新宿日本語学校](https://www.sng.ac.jp/jp/teacher-training/about/strength): Teacher training program features using Ezoe method with practicum
- [新宿日本語学校 | 1975年設立日本語教師養成講座 | 資格取得の学校](https://www.sng.ac.jp/fr/teacher-training/trial): 420-hour teacher certification program trial lesson (French version)

## Admission & Student Visa

- [Japanese language requirements for student visa](https://www.sng.ac.jp/admission/japanese-language-requirements-for-student-visa): Tokyo Immigration Bureau student visa Japanese language requirements
- [指定校推荐 | 星期六日语课程 - SNG](https://www.sng.ac.jp/cn/support/recommendation): Designated school recommendation program for university admission
- [Long-term Course Application](https://www.sng.ac.jp/ru/contact/long-term-application): Long-term course application form for student visa (Russian)
- [报名短期课程](https://www.sng.ac.jp/cn/contact/short-term-application): Short-term course application form for Chinese students

## Payment & Administrative Support

- [オンライン支払：新宿日本語学校SNG東京](https://www.sng.ac.jp/jp/admission/online-payment): Online payment via FLYWIRE for international tuition fees
- [Pembayaran online | Shinjuku Nihongo Gakko SNG](https://www.sng.ac.jp/id/admission/online-payment): Online payment via FLYWIRE for international students (Indonesian)

## About & Contact

- [О нашей школе | Институт японского языка Синдзюку - SNG](https://www.sng.ac.jp/ru/about): About Shinjuku Japanese Language Institute with 40 years experience
